what_this_is: Four SEPARATE identities for this work. They are not interchangeable, and a reader given only one of them cannot verify the others.

analysis_run_sha.why_absent: the frozen runs executed at a single clean revision of a source workspace that is not published; its identifier is deliberately not recorded here
analysis_run_sha.scope: the source revision that executed the frozen runs

scientific_source_digest.identical_note: the analysis and release digests are identical: the four panels were re-run at the same results-determining source and configuration digest this release ships, so there is no delta to explain. NOT the same Git tree -- documentation, tests, scripts and comments sit outside the digest and are regenerated or corrected after the run they describe

initial_content_commit.note: first commit holding the content. Release HEAD is one commit LATER: writing this value is itself a commit, so a commit cannot record its own SHA. The two are separate identities.

release_tag.note: assigned at publication. Points at release HEAD, which is this commit -- one after initial_content_commit.

interpreter.note: the digest is comparable only under this CPython minor version: ast.dump output differs across 3.11 / 3.12 / 3.13+ for identical source. Pinned by .python-version.
